pages.title: Liquid Methane
pages.text: CH₄ at 94 K, with a little ethane and nitrogen dissolved in it: the stuff of Titan's seas, rivers and rain. Less than half as dense as water, and too thin to swim in. Found in Titan's seas and lakes.
